name: browser-automation-studio.smoke-flow
purpose: Execute one persisted BAS workflow with wait and classify the outcome from the first failed timeline entry (action type and driver error code) into a closed failure vocabulary.

parameters.description: ExecutionParameters object passed to the execute binding (the CLI's --parameters-file reads the same message from a file). A file path is rejected as invalid_input. A session profile is applied only through this object; the execute binding has no profile argument.

assumptions: browser-automation-studio is running and its playwright-driver is ready
the caller may execute the named workflow; a mutating workflow needs the confirmation the workflow's labels declare

executions/timeline is read in-kernel with rows="entries" (the response carries two repeated fields, entries and logs); the failed entry is the one whose aggregates.status is STEP_STATUS_FAILED or whose context.error is set
context.errorCode carries the playwright-driver's code (ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND, NOT_FOUND, NO_BOUNDING_BOX, a TIMEOUT code); an entry without a code and without a wait action classifies as step_failed
invariants: exactly one execution is started per submission; no retry
act calls only workflows/execute; every read after the run happens in classify
no binding with effect destructive is called
no row set above 200 timeline entries is materialized; other readings are head(1) and count
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

bindings.note: Called with rows="entries"; unreadable timeline degrades the class to step_failed.

signals.execution_id: execution UUID created by the run
signals.failed_step: 1-based index of the first failed timeline entry, or null
signals.failed_action: ACTION_TYPE_* of the failed entry, or null
signals.failed_error_code: context.errorCode of the failed entry, or null
signals.timeline_entries: count of timeline entries, or null when the timeline was not read
signals.screenshot_count: count of screenshots retained for the execution, or null when unreadable

outputs.evidence: workflow:<id>, execution:<id>, node:<id> of the failed entry

budget.async_reason: workflows/execute with wait can outrun the 120 s synchronous bound; submit with --async and wait once.

fixtures.note: Expects failed/workflow_not_found. Recorded as unavailable when browser-automation-studio is down (2026-09-02: start-failed, api build exit 1).

Demo Smoke Workflow in folder /demo, discovered from `browser-automation-studio workflows list` on this host (2 completed executions on 2026-09-02). Re-discover the id on another host. Recorded as unavailable when the playwright-driver is down.
